description: Defines the LoanInterestData class which encapsulates interest-related financial data for a loan, including fields for charged, paid, waived, written-off, and outstanding interest amounts. Also contains a nested Mapstruct Mapper interface for converting a LoanSummary domain object into LoanInterestData.

classes.name: LoanInterestData
classes.description: Data holder for various interest amounts related to a loan, used for transfer or serialization purposes.

classes.name: LoanInterestData.Mapper
classes.description: Mapstruct mapper interface for converting LoanSummary domain objects into LoanInterestData DTOs.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a LoanSummary object to a LoanInterestData object, translating domain model fields to DTO fields.
